lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Mn2Mg4O8 (reduced formula LiMnMg2O4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/acd (No. 143), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li and Mn each in tetrahedral environments with four O neighbors, while Mg adopts an octahedral environment with six O neighbors. The O centers are two-coordinate, linking one Li and one Mn. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Li and Mn tetrahedra and between Mg octahedra and Li or Mn tetrahedra, with an overall three-dimensional connectivity network.
